title: Major League Soccer returns to Apple TV tomorrow

paragraphs.en: Major League Soccer resumes its regular season in July after a summer of international soccer. Major League Soccer returns to Apple TV tomorrow, July 16, as regular-season play resumes and the league welcomes fans back following a monthlong break for the FIFA World Cup. Apple TV subscribers in more than 100 countries and regions can watch every MLS match with no blackouts. Subscribers also receive comprehensive coverage and analysis, exclusive content, and access to matches beyond the regular season, including the annual Leagues Cup tournament, Michelob ULTRA Campeones Cup, MLS All-Star Game, and Audi MLS Cup Playoffs. All 30 clubs return to action following the World Cup Final, with six marquee matchups scheduled across July 16 and 17. Highlights include the Cascadia Cup rivalry between the Seattle Sounders and Portland Timbers, a Southern showdown between Nashville SC and Atlanta United FC, and the latest edition of El Tráfico featuring the LA Galaxy and Los Angeles Football Club. Major League Soccer returns on July 16, with every match streaming live on Apple TV. A record 45 MLS players, representing 22 clubs and 17 countries, participated in the 2026 World Cup, with many expected to return to their clubs this week as the league resumes regular-season play. Among them are eight players who represented the United States, including Vancouver Whitecaps FC midfielder Sebastian Berhalter, who helped the U.S. achieve its best group-stage finish at the World Cup. The group also includes Columbus Crew defender Steven Moreira, who started every match for Cape Verde as the Blue Sharks made an unforgettable run to the round of 32 in the nation’s first-ever World Cup, and nine Canadian internationals, led by Orlando City SC goalkeeper Maxime Crépeau, who played every minute of Canada’s historic tournament as the nation earned its first World Cup victory and advanced to the knockout stage for the first time. Other MLS players also made history at the World Cup, led by soccer icon and Inter Miami CF captain Lionel Messi, who further cemented his legacy by becoming the tournament’s all-time leading scorer. Messi has scored eight goals while captaining Argentina in its pursuit of a second consecutive World Cup title. New international stars add even more excitement to the MLS restart this summer.
paragraphs.zh: 经过一个夏天的国际足球赛事之后，美国职业足球大联盟（MLS）将于七月恢复常规赛季。 美国职业足球大联盟将于明天（7月16日）重返 Apple TV，届时常规赛季将重新开赛，联赛也将在一月因 FIFA 世界杯而中断后，再次欢迎球迷回归。 超过 100 个国家和地区的 Apple TV 订阅用户都可以观看所有 MLS 比赛，且没有任何地区限制。 订阅用户还将获得全面的赛事报道与分析、独家内容，以及常规赛季之外比赛的观看权限，包括年度联赛杯（Leagues Cup）、Michelob ULTRA 冠军杯（Campeones Cup）、MLS 全明星赛和奥迪 MLS 杯季后赛。 所有 30 支球队都将在世界杯决赛后重返赛场，其中 7 月 16 日至 17 日将安排六场备受瞩目的焦点对决。 亮点包括西雅图音速队与波特兰伐木者队之间的“卡斯卡迪亚杯”德比、纳什维尔 SC 与亚特兰大联队的南方对决，以及由洛杉矶银河队与洛杉矶足球俱乐部联袂出战的最新一届“El Tráfico”德比。 美国职业足球大联盟将于 7 月 16 日回归，所有比赛都将在 Apple TV 上直播。 创纪录的 45 名 MLS 球员代表 22 家俱乐部和 17 个国家参加了 2026 年世界杯，预计其中许多球员将在本周联赛恢复常规赛季比赛后返回各自俱乐部。 其中包括八名代表美国出战的球员，例如温哥华白帽队中场塞巴斯蒂安·贝尔哈尔特，他帮助美国队取得了世界杯小组赛阶段的最佳成绩。 该小组还包括哥伦布机员队后卫史蒂文·莫雷拉，他在佛得角队的首次世界杯之旅中每场比赛都首发出场，带领“蓝鲨”队创造了令人难忘的八强战绩；此外还有九名加拿大国家队球员，由奥兰多城 SC 门将马克西姆·克雷波领衔，他在加拿大队的历史性赛事中全勤出场，帮助球队取得了首胜并首次晋级淘汰赛阶段。 其他 MLS 球员也在世界杯上创造了历史，其中最引人注目的是足球偶像兼迈阿密国际队队长莱昂内尔·梅西，他凭借成为本届赛事历史最佳射手，进一步巩固了自己的传奇地位。 梅西在带领阿根廷队追逐第二个连续世界杯冠军的过程中，已经打入了八粒进球。 新的国际球星将为今年夏天 MLS 的回归增添更多激动人心的时刻。

paragraphs.en: Antoine Griezmann, the decorated French international and 2018 World Cup champion, has joined Orlando City SC after spending 10 seasons with Spanish giant Atlético Madrid, where he became the club’s all-time leading scorer. Scottish goalkeeper Angus Gunn, who started all three of his nation’s World Cup matches, has joined the San Jose Earthquakes, while Polish striker and global soccer icon Robert Lewandowski signed with the Chicago Fire during the summer transfer window. Stay Up to Date with Major League Soccer on Apple Sports Fans can stay on top of the latest scores, stats, and standings for their favorite clubs throughout the MLS season on the free Apple Sports app for iPhone. Users can easily navigate between scores and upcoming matches; explore visual lineup formations, play-by-play information, and team stats; and tap to watch matches on the Apple TV app. Apple Fitness+ Time to Walk with Thomas Müller Time to Walk is an Apple Fitness+ audio experience for iPhone and Apple Watch, designed to help people walk more often by featuring guests who share stories, photos, and songs that have shaped their lives. The new episode invites listeners to walk with German soccer legend and Vancouver Whitecaps star Thomas Müller as he reflects on the hard work he put in before his career took off and shares why he welcomes the challenge of big life changes. German soccer legend and Vancouver Whitecaps star Thomas Müller reflects on his career and the challenge of big life changes in a new episode of Time to Walk. More Ways to Celebrate the Return of MLS On Apple Music, fans can enjoy exclusive club- and player-curated selections, including a new Warm-Up Playlist for Real Salt Lake star Diego Luna. Fans can also look forward to more exclusive music content coming throughout the season, including playlists from Inter Miami’s Dayne St. Clair and Vancouver Whitecaps’ Sebastian Berhalter — fresh off their return from the World Cup. Explore the Sounds of MLS playlists on Apple Music at apple.co/AM-MLS . Apple Maps users can explore dedicated Matchday Guides created by MLS clubs and city guides created by players to find recommendations for local restaurants to catch a game, explore city favorites, get detailed information about their stadiums, and more.
paragraphs.zh: 功勋卓著的法国国脚、2018年世界杯冠军安托万·格里兹曼，在效力于西班牙豪门马德里竞技10个赛季后，已加盟奥兰多城足球俱乐部。他在马竞期间成为该俱乐部队史最佳射手。曾代表苏格兰队出战全部三场世界杯比赛的门将安格斯·冈恩，已加入圣何塞地震队；而波兰前锋、全球足坛偶像罗伯特·莱万多夫斯基则在夏季转会窗口与芝加哥火焰队签约。通过Apple Sports随时了解美国职业足球大联盟的最新动态。球迷们可以通过iPhone上的免费Apple Sports应用程序，在整个MLS赛季中随时掌握自己喜爱俱乐部的最新比分、数据和排名。用户可以轻松切换比分和即将进行的比赛；查看直观的阵容阵型、实时比赛信息和球队数据；还可以点击在Apple TV应用程序中观看比赛。Apple Fitness+：与托马斯·穆勒同行。“与托马斯·穆勒同行”是Apple Fitness+为iPhone和Apple Watch推出的一项音频体验，旨在通过邀请嘉宾分享塑造他们人生的故事、照片和歌曲，鼓励人们更经常地散步。新一期节目邀请听众与德国足球传奇人物、温哥华白浪队球星托马斯·穆勒一同漫步，他将回顾自己在职业生涯腾飞前付出的努力，并分享自己为何乐于迎接重大人生变化的挑战。德国足球传奇人物、温哥华白浪队球星托马斯·穆勒在《与托马斯·穆勒同行》新一期中，回顾了自己的职业生涯以及应对重大人生变化所带来的挑战。更多庆祝MLS回归的方式：在Apple Music上，球迷们可以欣赏到由俱乐部和球员独家策划的歌单，包括为皇家盐湖城球星迭戈·卢纳特别打造的全新“热身歌单”。球迷们还可以期待整个赛季期间推出的更多独家音乐内容，包括刚刚从世界杯归来的迈阿密国际队戴恩·圣克莱尔和温哥华白浪队塞巴斯蒂安·贝尔哈尔特的专属歌单。访问apple.co/AM-MLS，在Apple Music上探索“MLS之声”歌单。Apple Maps用户可以查看由MLS俱乐部专门制作的比赛日指南以及球员创作的城市指南，获取当地餐厅推荐、城市热门景点信息、球场详细资料等实用内容。

paragraphs.en: To mark the return of Major League Soccer, adidas will host a two-day celebration at the adidas Home of Soccer in Brooklyn, New York, on July 16 and 17, featuring watch parties, appearances by MLS players, an MLS jersey showcase, and additional fan experiences. Apple TV offers premium, compelling drama and comedy series, feature films, groundbreaking documentaries, and kids and family entertainment, and is available to watch across all of a user’s favorite screens. After its launch on November 1, 2019, Apple TV became the first all-original streaming service to launch around the world, and has premiered more original hits and received more award recognitions faster than any other streaming service in its debut. Commercial establishments now have multiple ways to bring Apple TV’s live sports portfolio to their patrons. With DIRECTV FOR BUSINESS, customers can also access Apple TV’s live sports programming at more than 300,000 sports bars, restaurants, hotels, and other commercial venues. EverPass offers commercial establishments access to Apple TV’s complete live sports portfolio — including every MLS match, Formula 1 in the U.S., and “Friday Night Baseball” — through its EverPass Core package. About Apple TV Apple TV is available on the Apple TV app in over 100 countries and regions, on over one billion screens, including iPhone; iPad; Apple TV 4K; Apple Vision Pro; Mac; popular smart TVs from Samsung, LG, Sony, VIZIO, TCL, and others; Roku and Amazon Fire TV devices; Chromecast with Google TV; PlayStation and Xbox gaming consoles; and at tv.apple.com , for $12.99 per month with a seven-day free trial for new subscribers. 1 For a limited time, customers who purchase and activate a new iPhone, iPad, Apple TV 4K, or Mac can enjoy three months of Apple TV for free. 2 Share article Media Text of this article
paragraphs.zh: 为庆祝美国职业足球大联盟（MLS）回归，阿迪达斯将于 7 月 16 日至 17 日在纽约布鲁克林的阿迪达斯足球之家举办为期两天的庆祝活动，内容包括观赛派对、MLS 球员亮相、MLS 球衣展示以及更多球迷互动体验。 Apple TV 提供高品质、引人入胜的剧集和喜剧系列、故事片、开创性纪录片以及儿童和家庭娱乐内容，用户可在所有喜爱的设备上观看。 自 2019 年 11 月 1 日上线以来，Apple TV 成为首个在全球同步推出的全原创流媒体服务，并在首秀阶段比其他任何流媒体服务都更快地推出了更多原创热门作品并获得了更多奖项认可。 如今，商业机构有多种方式可将 Apple TV 的现场体育内容带给顾客。 通过 DIRECTV FOR BUSINESS，客户还可在超过 30 万家体育酒吧、餐厅、酒店和其他商业场所观看 Apple TV 的现场体育赛事。 EverPass 通过其 EverPass Core 套餐，为商业机构提供 Apple TV 完整的现场体育内容库——包括所有 MLS 比赛、美国境内的一级方程式赛车以及“周五之夜棒球”赛事。 关于 Apple TV：Apple TV 可在超过 100 个国家和地区的 Apple TV 应用程序中观看，覆盖超过十亿台设备，包括 iPhone、iPad、Apple TV 4K、Apple Vision Pro、Mac；三星、LG、索尼、VIZIO、TCL 等品牌的热门智能电视；Roku 和亚马逊 Fire TV 设备；搭载谷歌电视的 Chromecast；PlayStation 和 Xbox 游戏主机；以及 tv.apple.com 网站。新订阅用户每月费用为 12.99 美元，并享有七天免费试用期。1 在有限时间内，购买并激活新款 iPhone、iPad、Apple TV 4K 或 Mac 的用户可免费享受三个月的 Apple TV 服务。2 分享文章 媒体 本文文本

paragraphs.en: All 30 clubs return to action following the World Cup Final, with six marquee matchups scheduled across July 16 and 17. Highlights include the Cascadia Cup rivalry between the Seattle Sounders and Portland Timbers, a Southern showdown between Nashville SC and Atlanta United FC, and the latest edition of El Tráfico featuring the LA Galaxy and Los Angeles Football Club.
paragraphs.zh: 世界杯决赛结束后，全部 30 家俱乐部将重返赛场，7 月 16 日至 17 日共安排了六场焦点对决。 亮点包括西雅图音速队与波特兰伐木者队之间的卡斯卡迪亚杯德比、纳什维尔 SC 与亚特兰大联队之间的南部对决，以及洛杉矶银河队与洛杉矶足球俱乐部联袂上演的最新一期“El Tráfico”大战。

paragraphs.en: A record 45 MLS players, representing 22 clubs and 17 countries, participated in the 2026 World Cup, with many expected to return to their clubs this week as the league resumes regular-season play. Among them are eight players who represented the United States, including Vancouver Whitecaps FC midfielder Sebastian Berhalter, who helped the U.S. achieve its best group-stage finish at the World Cup. The group also includes Columbus Crew defender Steven Moreira, who started every match for Cape Verde as the Blue Sharks made an unforgettable run to the round of 32 in the nation’s first-ever World Cup, and nine Canadian internationals, led by Orlando City SC goalkeeper Maxime Crépeau, who played every minute of Canada’s historic tournament as the nation earned its first World Cup victory and advanced to the knockout stage for the first time.
paragraphs.zh: 共有45名MLS球员参赛，他们分别来自22家俱乐部和17个国家，参加了2026年世界杯。随着联赛常规赛的重启，预计本周将有许多球员返回各自俱乐部。 其中，有八名球员代表美国队参赛，包括温哥华白浪足球俱乐部的中场球员塞巴斯蒂安·贝尔哈尔特，他帮助美国队取得了世界杯小组赛阶段的最佳成绩。 该小组还包括哥伦布机员队的后卫史蒂文·莫雷拉，他在佛得角队的首次世界杯之旅中每场比赛都首发出场，带领“蓝鲨”队创造了令人难忘的八强战绩；此外还有九名加拿大国家队球员，由奥兰多城足球俱乐部门将马克西姆·克雷波领衔，他在加拿大队这场历史性赛事中全勤出场，帮助球队取得了首胜，并首次晋级淘汰赛阶段。

paragraphs.en: Other MLS players also made history at the World Cup, led by soccer icon and Inter Miami CF captain Lionel Messi, who further cemented his legacy by becoming the tournament’s all-time leading scorer. Messi has scored eight goals while captaining Argentina in its pursuit of a second consecutive World Cup title.
paragraphs.zh: 其他 MLS 球员也在世界杯上创造了历史，其中最突出的是足球偶像兼迈阿密国际队队长莱昂内尔·梅西，他凭借成为该赛事历史最佳射手，进一步巩固了自己的传奇地位。 在带领阿根廷队追逐第二个连续世界杯冠军的过程中，梅西已经打入了八个进球。

paragraphs.en: New international stars add even more excitement to the MLS restart this summer. Antoine Griezmann, the decorated French international and 2018 World Cup champion, has joined Orlando City SC after spending 10 seasons with Spanish giant Atlético Madrid, where he became the club’s all-time leading scorer. Scottish goalkeeper Angus Gunn, who started all three of his nation’s World Cup matches, has joined the San Jose Earthquakes, while Polish striker and global soccer icon Robert Lewandowski signed with the Chicago Fire during the summer transfer window.
paragraphs.zh: 新的国际球星为今年夏天美国职业足球大联盟的重启增添了更多激动人心的时刻。 功勋卓著的法国国脚、2018年世界杯冠军安托万·格里兹曼，在西班牙豪门马德里竞技效力10个赛季并成为俱乐部历史最佳射手后，现已加盟奥兰多城足球俱乐部。 曾代表苏格兰队出战全部三场世界杯比赛的门将安格斯·冈恩已加入圣何塞地震队，而波兰前锋、全球足坛偶像罗伯特·莱万多夫斯基则在夏季转会窗口期间与芝加哥火焰队签约。

paragraphs.en: Apple Fitness+ Time to Walk with Thomas Müller
paragraphs.zh: Apple Fitness+ 与托马斯·穆勒的步行时光

paragraphs.en: Time to Walk is an Apple Fitness+ audio experience for iPhone and Apple Watch, designed to help people walk more often by featuring guests who share stories, photos, and songs that have shaped their lives. The new episode invites listeners to walk with German soccer legend and Vancouver Whitecaps star Thomas Müller as he reflects on the hard work he put in before his career took off and shares why he welcomes the challenge of big life changes.
paragraphs.zh: 《Time to Walk》是 Apple Fitness+ 推出的一项适用于 iPhone 和 Apple Watch 的音频体验，旨在通过邀请嘉宾分享塑造他们人生的故事、照片和歌曲，鼓励人们更经常地散步。 新一集邀请听众与德国足球传奇人物、温哥华白浪队球星托马斯·穆勒一同漫步，他将回顾自己在职业生涯腾飞前付出的努力，并分享自己为何乐于迎接重大人生变化的挑战。

paragraphs.en: Apple TV offers premium, compelling drama and comedy series, feature films, groundbreaking documentaries, and kids and family entertainment, and is available to watch across all of a user’s favorite screens.
